channel.title: Robotics Directory - Quadruped Robots
channel.description: Browse 200 quadruped robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Astrall Dynamics Hypertron-T01
item.description: Heavy-duty quadruped firefighting robot from Shenzhen-based Astrall Dynamics. The Hypertron-T01 combines an 80 kg dynamic payload, IP67 protection, thermal imaging, gas detection and 3D LiDAR for unmanned suppression and reconnaissance in hazardous environments.

item.title: Dax Robotics Qiji T1000
item.description: Rideable ton-class quadruped robot horse for heavy loads and difficult terrain.

item.title: Satyress Robotics Threehalves
item.description: Teleoperated centaur-style 'superhumanoid' prototype with quadruped base, humanoid torso and horned goat-like head. Quick-connect wrist interface supplies 12/18/48 V power and compressed air to tools such as chainsaws and drills; all limbs swappable and recalibratable in minutes. Passive failsafes: friction-braked joints plus air brakes and pin locks immobilize the robot on pressure loss. Aimed at forestry, wildfire and disaster-zone work; prototype, commercial version 2+ years away.

item.title: xTerra Robotics Svan M2
item.description: India's first commercial quadruped, carbon-fibre 12-DoF for inspection and defence.

item.title: Faraday Future FX Aegis
item.description: Professional embodied-AI quadruped for security and companionship; price and specifications describe the Aegis Pro configuration.

item.title: Faraday Future FX Navi
item.description: Smartphone-powered educational quadruped: 12 joint motors, 46.5x20x51.5 cm, runs on an iOS/Android brain.

item.title: RIVR Milo
item.description: Rebranded from Swiss-Mile, this high-speed wheel-legged quadruped can stand on hind legs to manipulate environments, carrying up to 50kg at speeds up to 22 km/h.

item.title: Unitree AS2-W
item.description: Wheel-legged As2-W family with X and EDU columns. Both list 16 joint motors, 7-inch wheels, about 16 kg walking load and IP54 protection. Charging dock and compute-expansion packages require the selected edition.

item.title: MagicLab MagicDog T1
item.description: Light industrial quadruped shown by MagicLab at WAIC 2026 alongside MagicBot X1 and MagicBot D1; detailed public specifications were not available.

item.title: DEEP Robotics Yunju
item.description: Limited-edition biomimetic robot horse for the Year of the Horse, based on DEEP Robotics' Lynx M20 platform and shown at WAIC 2026; about 30 kg, 50 kg payload and up to 5 m/s.

item.title: UNIUBI AI Lingmao (Cyberling / Cyvet)
item.description: Cyber pet and open development platform with NVIDIA Jetson Orin options, stereo vision, voice interaction, autonomous navigation and 12 high-performance joints; performed the world's first continuous 720° backflip at WAIC 2026.

item.title: Helsing RX-1
item.description: European defense robotics research platform developed by Helsing's Area 9 incubator. Full robotic stack built in-house (hardware and software) for autonomous navigation research in debris-laden and unpredictable environments. Partnerships with ETH Zurich (Marco Hutter group) and INRIA Paris. Designed and owned in Europe.

item.title: Unitree As2 AIR
item.description: As2 AIR is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 10 kg continuous-walking load and about 65 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is not supported in this variant. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 PRO
item.description: As2 PRO is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 13 kg continuous-walking load and about 75 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is not supported in this variant. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 X
item.description: As2 X is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 15 kg continuous-walking load and about 95 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is supported. Variant-specific battery, perception and accessories are kept separate.

item.title: Unitree As2 EDU
item.description: As2 EDU is a twelve-joint legged quadruped with about 15 kg continuous-walking load and about 95 N·m peak joint torque. Secondary development is supported. A charging dock and compute expansion are listed for EDU.

item.title: Unitree As2-W X
item.description: As2-W X wheel-legged configuration with 16 joint motors and about 16 kg continuous-walking load. The X column does not list a charging dock or high-compute expansion.

item.title: Unitree As2-W EDU
item.description: As2-W EDU wheel-legged configuration with 16 joint motors and about 16 kg continuous-walking load. EDU lists a charging dock and selectable compute expansion.

item.title: China Mobile Lingxi
item.description: In-house home companion robot dog (灵犀) released Apr 23, 2026 for families with children and elderly members. It offers spatial perception, identity recognition, indoor/outdoor following and about one minute of voice cloning.

item.title: Kepler Robotics Qilin
item.description: Hybrid-drive quadruped (麒麟) for inspection and rescue, unveiled by Kepler at WAIC 2026.

item.title: GLRoad D2-W
item.description: Industrial quadruped robot that can step, glide and crawl. It has an IP67 rating, hot-swappable dual batteries, climbs continuous 25 cm stairs and runs from -20 to 50 °C. It has passed power-grid equipment quality inspection and launched at WRC 2026.

item.title: Shenmou Technology Fumo
item.description: Arm-equipped quadruped robot from Shenmou Technology that won a State Grid tender for quadruped robots in complex environments in October 2026. It integrates a robotic arm and an electromagnetic-interference-resistant dexterous hand on a legged body to inspect and work in narrow, damp and flooded legacy power-cable tunnels without on-site power or network, using multimodal perception for defect recognition and dynamic visual servoing.

item.title: Petoi Chairo Robot
item.description: Chairo Robot is an ESP32-powered quadruped robot dog from Petoi for coding and AI learning, supporting Python, C++ and block programming. It offers modular expansion with robotic arms, cameras and IR, gesture and motion sensors, plus Raspberry Pi integration.

item.title: Weilan BabyAlpha A3
item.description: BabyAlpha A3 is Weilan's consumer quadruped companion robot and successor to the BabyAlpha A2, unveiled in May 2026 with a planned third-quarter 2026 market launch. It upgrades perception with a three-camera vision system, runs a 7-billion-parameter large model locally, and walks with autonomous navigation instead of relying on a remote control.

item.title: Hiwonder MechDog AI
item.description: MechDog AI is Hiwonder's 2026 ESP32 robot dog that adds a 3-DOF lightweight robotic arm and a WonderLLM AI module with a 2 MP camera, microphone and speaker to the eight-servo MechDog platform. It connects to large language models such as DeepSeek, Doubao and Qwen for vision, voice and grasping tasks, is programmable in Scratch, Arduino and Python, and runs on a 7.4 V 1,500 mAh battery.

item.title: Topstar Xingzai
item.description: Heavy-duty industrial quadruped robot 'Xingzai' from Topstar, launched in January 2026 for inspection and forest firefighting. It is rated IP66, reaches 5 m/s, runs up to 8 hours or 20 km, climbs 20 cm obstacles and 45-degree slopes, and carries 80 kg while moving (200 kg static).

item.title: Dongfeng Motor Yuanzai
item.description: Yuanzai is a wheel-legged quadruped robot developed in-house by Dongfeng Motor's R&D institute, shown alongside the humanoid robot Xiaodong at the 2026 World Robot Conference in August 2026. Dongfeng plans to trial it, together with Xiaodong, at its Wuhan-area factories and 4S dealership stores as part of the automaker's push into embodied-intelligence robotics.

item.title: Qiteng Robot X5
item.description: Explosion-proof wheel-legged quadruped from Chongqing-based Qiteng Robot, launched at the company's brand event in Chongqing in September 2026. It combines wheeled driving with legged obstacle crossing to handle stairs, bunds and slopes in hazardous industrial plants, adjusting its posture autonomously, and runs on Qiteng's motion-control, perception, navigation and fleet-dispatch stack.

item.title: Chengxin Zhilian Xun 3
item.description: Industrial inspection robot dog from Wuhan-based Chengxin Zhilian, launched in August 2026 at the Hubei Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. It carries a 32-line LiDAR, a dual-spectrum pan-tilt camera, a nine-in-one gas sensor and a robotic arm that can press buttons to contain risks; it climbs 25 steps and 35-degree slopes and runs about 4 hours or 20 km per charge, using the company's in-house inertial navigation for autonomous patrols.

item.title: 58 Intelligent (Norinco) Tianlang Q10W
item.description: Wheel-legged quadruped from 58 Intelligent, the automation institute company of China North Industries Group (Norinco), shown at WAIC 2026. It has a die-cast high-strength metal frame and in-house high-torque joints rated for an hour of continuous stair climbing, IP65 protection and a -20 to 55 °C operating range, and a modular quick-release design that one person can transport and deploy; it can be teleoperated for patrol, reconnaissance and hazardous-object removal.

item.title: 58 Intelligent (Norinco) Q5
item.description: Lightweight patrol and security wheel-legged quadruped series from Norinco's 58 Intelligent, shown at WAIC 2026. It weighs no more than 30 kg for one-person transport, reaches 3 m/s, climbs steps over 16 cm and slopes of at least 30 degrees, and offers autonomous patrol and recharging, person following, remote broadcast, two-way intercom, video capture and AI recognition with cloud OTA updates.

item.title: Yuanshan Zhixing Xiaoyuan
item.description: Wheel-legged guide-dog robot for visually impaired people from Yuanshan Zhixing, the consumer brand of China North Industries Group's Hangzhou Zhiyuan Research Institute, launched on 4 September 2026. It switches between rolling on flat ground and climbing stairs, navigates autonomously indoors and outdoors with at most 30 cm outdoor positioning error, detects overhanging obstacles such as branches and scaffolding (at least 99% indoor and 96% outdoor avoidance success), and offers voice interaction, reminders, distress calls and remote assistance.

item.title: DEEP Robotics X50
item.description: Heavy-payload industrial quadruped robot from DEEP Robotics (Jueying X50), unveiled on 6 November 2026 for power inspection, firefighting and emergency rescue. It carries a 50 kg continuous payload, runs at 3 m/s for over 2 km under rated load, is IP67-rated and supports autonomous charging and obstacle stopping.

item.title: DEEP Robotics X50 Pro
item.description: Pro version of DEEP Robotics' Jueying X50 heavy-payload industrial quadruped, unveiled in November 2026, adding SLAM mapping and autonomous navigation to the 50 kg-payload, IP67-rated platform. It weighs about 60 kg and runs at up to 4.5 m/s.

item.title: AGIBOT D2 Max
item.description: Next-generation flagship quadruped from AGIBOT's quadruped subsidiary AGIBOT Kutuo, previewed in April 2026 and positioned as an all-terrain L3-level autonomous quadruped for warehouse, park, utility-tunnel and construction-site inspection and material transport. It is part of the D2 series announced for launch in 2026 in large, medium and small sizes.

item.title: Mirror Me Apollo
item.description: Industrial quadruped robot from MirrorMe Technology (Mirror Me), shown at WRC 2025 and formally launched with manufacturing partner Kaierda in January 2026 for power inspection, factory work and emergency response. It weighs about 65 kg, carries a 50 kg continuous walking payload, moves at up to 5 m/s, is IP67-rated and offers optional lidar navigation, autonomous charging and 10-second battery swaps.

item.title: Mirror Me Black Panther W
item.description: Modular industrial wheel-legged robot dog (BPW, with a BPW-Auto variant) from MirrorMe Technology with 16 joints and quick-swap coupled power modules, publicly debuted at the 2026 Robot Warrior Challenge ahead of market launch. It weighs about 30 kg, carries 20 kg continuously, reaches 5 m/s, climbs 50 cm and 45-degree slopes, is IP66-rated and runs about 6 hours unloaded.

item.title: Xi'an Quantum Intelligence Technology Q-Quadruped Pro
item.description: Explosion-proof four-wheel-legged inspection robot from Xi'an Quantum Intelligence Technology, launched in May 2026 for oil, gas and petrochemical plants. It is certified Ex IIC T6 Gb for Zone 0/1/2 explosive atmospheres, is IP66-rated, and carries an explosion-proof gimbal with more than ten sensors for meter reading, infrared temperature measurement, gas-leak detection and abnormal-sound diagnosis.

item.title: Huaxiang Qiyuan P30
item.description: Multimodal quadruped robot from Ningbo Huaxiang Qiyuan Technology, the robotics subsidiary of auto-parts maker Ningbo Huaxiang, shown at WAIC and WRC 2026 and in volume production. It carries an effective payload of more than 30 kg (150 kg maximum load), climbs 45-degree slopes, jumps over 1.6 m and has an unloaded range of 48 km.

item.title: Genisom AI L2
item.description: Industry-grade quadruped (Chinese name Gangbeng L2) from Genisom AI / Zhishen Technology, launched in June 2026 as the successor to the L1 with more than twice its power. It weighs 21 kg, carries about 16 kg continuously (150 kg static), climbs 22 cm stairs and 40-degree slopes, reaches 5 m/s peak speed, is IP66-rated and uses a 756 Wh battery; prices start at 39,999 CNY.

item.title: Genisom AI L2-W
item.description: Wheel-legged version of Genisom AI's (Zhishen Technology) L2 industry-grade quadruped, launched in 2026 with four hub-motor wheels on its legs. It weighs 27 kg, carries about 16 kg continuously, climbs 25 cm stairs and 40-degree slopes, reaches 5 m/s peak speed and is IP66-rated.

item.title: Genisom AI L2-W Ultra
item.description: Top variant of Genisom AI's (Zhishen Technology) L2 wheel-legged quadruped series, launched in 2026, adding lidar and vision fusion autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance to the 27 kg, IP66-rated L2-W platform. It carries about 16 kg continuously and climbs 25 cm stairs.

item.title: Genisom AI SP1
item.description: Explosion-proof wheel-legged inspection quadruped from Genisom AI / Zhishen Technology (Chinese name 'Shot Put SP1'), unveiled at WAIC 2026 for petrochemical, energy and other Zone 1/Zone 2 explosive-gas environments. It weighs up to 100 kg, carries 50 kg, runs at least 4 hours, climbs 23 cm steps and 35-degree slopes, is IP66-rated, Ex d IIC T6 Gb certified, and supports wired or wireless charging.

item.title: Genisom AI L1 Maker
item.description: Educational quadruped kit from Genisom AI / Zhishen Technology for component-level hands-on assembly, built on the mass-produced L1 platform and debuted internationally at IROS 2026. Students build, calibrate and program a 15 kg, 12-joint industry-grade robot dog that carries about 8 kg and climbs 16 cm stairs.

item.title: Genisom AI M1 Pro
item.description: Navigation version of Genisom AI's (Zhishen Technology) Tongchui M1 wheel-legged quadruped, launched in March 2026 as an industry-grade robot dog with 3D multi-floor mapping and navigation for cross-scene inspection. It shares the M1's 41 kg, IP67 platform with 30 kg payload and hot-swappable dual batteries.

item.title: Genisom AI M1 Ultra
item.description: Top variant of Genisom AI's (Zhishen Technology) Tongchui M1 wheel-legged quadruped series, launched in March 2026 with a 720-degree 3D surround perception system derived from automotive driver-assistance sensing for narrow passages, one-way corridors and steep slopes in patrol, inspection and rescue work.

item.title: Wujing Dynamics (Nanjing Wujing Future Power Technology) Panshi P25-Ex
item.description: Explosion-proof wheel-legged robot dog (Chinese name 'Panshi/磐石 P25-Ex') from Nanjing startup Wujing Dynamics (南京无境未来动力科技有限公司), unveiled on 17 September 2026 for oil refining, fine chemicals, power plants and coal-chemical sites. It is certified to the IIC T6 explosion-proof rating, weighs 60 kg and carries a 30 kg rated payload. In late October 2026, multiple Chinese outlets (Sina Finance, 36Kr and others) reported the company had suspended operations, with its CEO unable to reach the actual controller, roughly 8 million CNY in unpaid wages, and zero deliveries despite a claimed ~1 billion CNY order book, raising serious doubts about the product's commercial status.

item.title: MICBOT (Juwei Technology) MOVENEW P3S
item.description: Next-generation heavy-load wheeled quadruped mobile work platform from MICBOT (Juwei Technology), announced for launch at China Hi-Tech Fair in November 2026 with liquid-cooled (P3S LC), Agile, explosion-proof (ExR), anti-magnetic (MagShield) and mining (KA) derivatives. It carries 100 kg while walking and climbing stairs (300 kg heavy-load mode), reaches 5 m/s on wheels, climbs 45-degree slopes and 35 cm steps and can mount a 100 cm platform.

item.title: China Mobile Lingxi M2
item.description: New-generation Lingxi family companion robot dog from China Mobile's Hangzhou R&D Center, launched on 13 November 2026 with JD.com pre-sales. It acts as a reading tutor, English speaking partner, automatic photographer and outdoor walking companion for children, and supports hundreds of agent apps with customizable voices, personas and characters.

item.title: China Mobile Lingxi M3
item.description: Lower-priced model of China Mobile Hangzhou R&D Center's new-generation Lingxi companion robot dog, launched on 13 November 2026 with JD.com pre-sales. It offers reading companionship, automatic photo capture of children, walking companionship and customizable voices and characters.
